why: pins every remaining constant, rule and definition used by the audit code so that no value can be chosen after seeing results. Chronology and central-projection-gap artifacts (no performance numbers) are committed with this amendment.

evaluation_periods.population: MEANINGFUL (incumbent eligibility: >=5 prior same-season games and prior-3 mean TOI >= 480 s; moneyline: both teams >=5 prior games; goalie: >=5 prior qualifying appearances)

incumbent_scoring.models: stored xgboost json under nhl_models/*_work (walk-forward dirs where present, champion-gate dir for goalie saves), scored with iteration_range (0, best_iteration+1)
forms: AS_SERVED_CAUSAL_PLATT: single pooled Platt map (player markets) / home-slice map (moneyline) refit before each week w on previous season + current-season rows with week < w, using the repository's own fit_platt/apply_platt (a<=0 falls back to identity)

frozen_constants.human_rate_shrink_target: FIT position-group (F = C/L/R, D) rate per hour and mean TOI per game
frozen_constants.expected_toi: mean TOI of the previous 3 games
frozen_constants.dispersion_rule: index = sum((y-mu)^2)/sum(mu) over FIT+2023 rows with the human mu; <=1.15 -> Poisson else negative binomial r = sum(mu^2)/sum((y-mu)^2-mu)
frozen_constants.goalie_human: SA_hat = L + 0.5*(opp_prior_shots_for_per_game - L), L = league season-to-date shots per team-game; sv% = (saves + 400*FIT_league_sv)/(shots_against + 400); mu = SA_hat*sv%

probability_baselines_exact.D: human mu mapped to P(X>=threshold) by the locked count distribution

moneyline.B: logistic on projected_margin (team_net_margin - opp_net_margin), coefficients from FIT only

per_season_verdict_rule.REJECTED: paired-bootstrap 95% CI of Brier(incumbent as served) - Brier(best of A,B,C by Brier that season) has lower bound > 0, OR ECE_10bin > 0.05
per_season_verdict_rule.SURVIVES: incumbent Brier lower than every baseline A,B,C,D AND CI upper bound of the difference vs the best baseline < 0 AND ECE_10bin <= 0.03

combination_rule: market native verdict = the WORSE of the 2024 and 2025 season verdicts (REJECTED worse than WEAK worse than SURVIVES). Goalie saves is reported as BLOCKED_TIMING with diagnostic verdicts for populations A and B.

catastrophic_miss_definitions.sog: incumbent served p <= 0.15 and actual SOG >= 6; OR |human mu - actual| > 3
catastrophic_miss_definitions.points: incumbent served p <= 0.10 and actual points >= 3; OR |human mu - actual| > 2
catastrophic_miss_definitions.goalie_saves: incumbent served p <= 0.15 and saves >= 35; OR p >= 0.85 and saves <= 15; OR |human mu - actual| > 8
catastrophic_miss_definitions.moneyline: served home p >= 0.80 and home lost, OR p <= 0.20 and home won

sog: TEAM_SHOT_ENVIRONMENT_HIGH (team shots that game >= 1.25x team prior mean)
cause_flags_evidence_only.rule: flags are descriptive, postgame, and only those listed; any miss with no flag is UNATTRIBUTED. Line, PP and starter causes cannot be tested (data absent) and are never assigned.

clean_ledger: CLEAN equals RAW in Phase0: production data holds no in-game injury, misconduct or goalie-injury exit flag, so no abnormal exit can be censored; exit labels are BLOCKED_DATA. Poor play, benching, goalie pulls, blowouts and empty-net are never censored.
raw_population_reporting: RAW row counts and incumbent coverage are reported per season; metrics are computed on MEANINGFUL only.
receipts: one compact receipt per audited MEANINGFUL player-game (and goalie / game) for 2024 and 2025 with only the fields that exist; unavailable components are omitted, never fabricated.

goalie_variants.B_APPEARANCE_CONDITIONAL_NO_TARGET_TOI_F: all appearances with >=5 prior qualifying appearances; calibration map pool = incumbent A rows as served; still conditioned on appearing

forward_state_and_timing: the forward-capture state branch and docs outcome files are not opened by Phase0
source_audit_scope: static review of repository code, committed contracts and V1 artifacts; no new provider retrieval
